classes.aristotelian_definition: A project that aims to deploy AI in wind farm control and asset management.
classes.comment: The TWAIN project focuses on efficient deployment of AI for cost, performance, and efficiency optimization.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A project developing novel designs in low trophic aquaculture pilots within offshore wind farm locations.
classes.comment: The ULTFARMS project aims to develop new designs for six pilot projects across the North and Baltic Seas.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A project developing prediction methods for production statistics and load performance of modern GW-scale wind energy systems.
classes.comment: The FLOW project focuses on new prediction methods for offshore and onshore wind energy systems.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A project developing innovative components for a 15 MW floating wind turbine.
classes.comment: The MADE4WIND project aims to introduce new designs and manufacturing techniques in lightweight materials.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A project developing nanocoatings for wind turbine performance improvement.
classes.comment: The Nanowings project aims to enhance wind turbine durability and performance with advanced coatings.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A project studying social acceptance drivers and barriers for wind energy.
classes.comment: The WIMBY project focuses on understanding the challenges of gaining public support for wind energy.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A project revolutionizing aerohydroelastic simulations in wind turbine research.
classes.comment: The DATA-DRIVEN OFFSHORE project aims to integrate experimental data into simulations.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A project developing wind-assisted propulsion solutions for shipping.
classes.comment: The Orcelle project aims to achieve significant energy efficiency gains in the shipping sector.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A project developing modular retrofit solutions for wind-assisted propulsion.
classes.comment: The WHISPER project aims to test the viability of a wingsail system in reducing CO2 emissions.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A project building and operating an offshore wind farm with integrated green hydrogen production.
classes.comment: The Nordsee Two Offshore Windfarm Innovation Project aims to demonstrate innovative technologies for energy generation.
